evidence: Row 44 source-and-weight audit only. The actual workbook Quality Checks!D45 asks that real functionality outweigh structure/style; Internal Quality Checks!E45 explicitly describes the 60% Functional share and weighted criteria within dimensions. Frozen tests/scoring.toml:5-11 is byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba): Functional 0.6, Polish 0.2, Visual 0.2; gates have zero reward mass. Frozen tools/score.py:40-48 applies those shares and the strict Functional >0.05 floor, and its SHA256 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e matches the template. Independent TOML arithmetic found 133 Functional criteria totaling 45: 35 coordinated-change criteria total 28 (62.2222% of Functional, 37.3333% of final reward), with 98 underlying-offer criteria totaling 17 (22.6667% final). This matches instruction.md:1-7 emphasis on coordinated transactions while retaining the underlying desk. Functional/judge.toml:905-1082 gives net-budget exchange 2.1, lineage/ABA/concurrent retries/overlap 2 each, signing/grants/stale-leaf refusal 1.5 each, and other independently observable batch outcomes 1 each. These require actions and persisted economic/history facts, not labels or page structure. The form/preview criterion at :951-956 is only 1/45 of Functional (1.3333% final); even the five exact financial-display computations at :95-137 total only 3.21513% final and are substantive calculations. Small split role/tier cells do not gain large weight merely through criterion count. Polish/judge.toml:17-50 totals 9 and proves four requested working recovery outcomes, rather than decorative polish: revision/rescission retention have 1.5 each, while coordinated stale and uncertain-commit recovery have 3 each. These are 3.3333%,3.3333%,6.6667%,6.6667% final, matching the brief emphasis on corrective/retry workflows. Visual/judge.toml:17-89 has five equally weighted craft axes (4% final each). Thus the two dimensions named nonfunctional can contribute at most 40%, below Functional 60%; actual pure style contributes at most 20%, because Polish requires successful recovery behavior. Counterexample attempt (reasoned, not executed): a beautifully styled complete old offer desk with coordinated changes absent cannot obtain the 28 batch weight or the two batch-recovery criteria. Even granting every underlying Functional point, both ordinary recovery points and all Visual points gives 0.6*(17/45)+0.2*(3/9)+0.2 = 0.493333 before rounding. A complete Functional implementation already has a 0.6 contribution without craft, and all behavioral/recovery outcomes contribute 0.8. A conforming alternative with different labels, generated IDs, semantic money/date formatting, no imported demonstration roster and a different desktop layout is explicitly permitted by functional/prompt.md:13,23 and visual/prompt.md:10; the weights introduce no demand for the reference layout or roster. No weight-specific false-fail or inflated structural criterion was found. Limits: the arithmetic above is a conditional scoring analysis, not a measured app score, Luna result, Oracle grade, configured judge run, or empirical ranking. The current raw index explicitly classifies its evidence as local only. Its three scored schema artifacts were independently SHA256-verified: functional 2c3dadbf9813af1a4dbcb8d6f80b27b50977a8cb01bb8fc5d1f3dc5cec6e13f4; polish 7001ec30abe745748e64b8ef204ef10353ebdcfa9151ce6e2d45ee51781e3bca; visual d379f49cab02b538d475b2af8a6f708af82ea2df1f258e0adb9556937381c623. These parser artifacts are not runtime score evidence. This Pass establishes only row 44 weight honesty from the frozen specification; required runtime evidence for other assigned rows remains unresolved by this review.
